text.tspan: 10 local CC0 schematics · independently styled paths · MCP recoloring verification

svg.title: Mammalian cell
svg.desc: Schematic mammalian cell with nucleus, mitochondria and internal membranes. Conceptual illustration, not to scale.

svg.title: Cell nucleus
svg.desc: Nuclear envelope, pores, chromatin fibers and nucleolus. Conceptual illustration, not to scale.

svg.title: Mitochondrion
svg.desc: Illustrative cross-section showing mitochondrial membranes and cristae. Conceptual illustration, not to scale.

svg.title: Endoplasmic reticulum
svg.desc: Folded rough endoplasmic reticulum with ribosome dots. Conceptual illustration, not to scale.

svg.title: Golgi apparatus
svg.desc: Stacked Golgi cisternae and transport vesicles. Conceptual illustration, not to scale.

svg.title: Plasma membrane
svg.desc: Phospholipid bilayer with polar heads, tails and a membrane protein. Conceptual illustration, not to scale.

svg.title: DNA double helix
svg.desc: Two stylized DNA backbones and base-pair rungs; not an atomic model. Conceptual illustration, not to scale.

svg.title: Protein complex
svg.desc: Illustrative multimeric complex with independently colored subunits. Conceptual illustration, not to scale.

svg.title: Cell surface receptor
svg.desc: Ligand-binding receptor with membrane span and intracellular domain. Conceptual illustration, not to scale.

svg.title: Lipid vesicle
svg.desc: Vesicle cross-section with a bilayer shell and luminal cargo. Conceptual illustration, not to scale.
